Pyrra queries the VictoriaMetrics vmsingle endpoint for SLI data.
The Prometheus rules implement the burn rate concepts described in the SLO guide.
Workstrator dispatches tasks to the gateway as a normal client.
Both use PR-based automation to land changes in protected branches.
Monitoring stack scrapes Cilium metrics for connectivity alerts.
Cilium mesh is homogenized onto Tailscale endpoints to fix cross-node connectivity.
The hardening plan is a direct outcome of an incident documented via postmortem processes.
Hermes uses Longhorn for RWX state storage.
The K8s ConfigMap mirrors the configuration used in the local Docker test environment.
The apps.yaml configures the logic running inside the container defined in compose.yaml.
